selection: Purposive re-screening of the retained DBLP-matched bibliography; covers source, representation, consumer, and role contrasts. Not an independent exhaustive database search.
process: AI-assisted extraction with passage reinspection and deterministic identity/link/count validation; no independent human double-coding, no agreement statistic, no model runs.
scope: All 21 analytical records are populated for the stated fields. The 52 additional references are contextual and do not enter quantitative contrasts; eight supporting full texts establish survey, resource, and component boundaries.

additional_scope_source.inspected: Official institutional abstract and bibliographic record; full text download timed out. No detailed absence-of-coverage claim is made.

unreported_fields: Hardware, full hyperparameters, annotation exhaustiveness and omitted configurations are outside this extraction unless named explicitly.

release_note.note: Historical Visual-RAG v1 model scores are excluded from quantitative synthesis because corrected image labels/QA and removed placeholder questions yield a 374-question release. The main oracle contrast instead uses published ACL Findings VideoRAG Table1.
